title: Too much Vs Much too
theory:
1                         Too much (Quantity)                                       cgqr T;knk
        2                           Much too (Degree)                                       cgqr T;knk
        3               Too many (For plural countable noun)                                cgqr T;knk
        4                          None too (Not very)                          bruk Hkh ugha@T;knk [kkl ugha
     Usage

    1    Too much + Noun (Uncountable)                     2   Much too + Adjective
         Example: She drinks too much coffee.                  Example: This book is much too expensive.

     3 Much too + Adverb                                   4    Too many + Noun (Plural)
         Example: He drives much too fast.                     Example: There are too many people here.

                             5 None too + Adjective
                               Example: The food here is none too good.
